description: Implement Paystack Subaccounts for store settlement, gate payments behind bank account setup, and apply a 1% customer processing fee.

userStories.title: Database Schema & Enums for Subaccounts
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to add subaccount fields and payment setup status to the database so that we can track store payment readiness and Paystack subaccount details.
acceptanceCriteria: Create a migration to add a new ENUM type `payment_setup_status` with values: 'pending_bank_account', 'subaccount_pending', 'ready', 'failed'
Add `payment_setup_status` (default 'pending_bank_account'), `payment_setup_error` (TEXT), and `platform_percentage_charge` (NUMERIC, default 10) to the `tenants` table

Add `paystack_subaccount_code`, `paystack_subaccount_id` (BIGINT), `paystack_subaccount_active` (BOOLEAN), `paystack_subaccount_status` (TEXT), `paystack_subaccount_error` (TEXT), and `settlement_schedule` (TEXT, default 'manual') to the `salon_payout_destinations` table
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Paystack Helpers for Subaccounts
userStories.description: As a backend system, I need helper functions to interact with the Paystack Subaccount API.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `createPaystackSubaccount` function to `supabase/functions/_shared/paystack-helpers.ts`
Function should call POST `https://api.paystack.co/subaccount` with `business_name`, `settlement_bank` (using bank_code), `account_number`, `percentage_charge`, and `settlement_schedule: "manual"`
Add `updatePaystackSubaccount` function for PUT `https://api.paystack.co/subaccount/:id_or_code`
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Update Payout Destination Creation
userStories.description: As a salon owner, when I add my bank account, a Paystack subaccount should be automatically created so I can receive online payments.
acceptanceCriteria: Update `create-payout-destination` Edge Function to call `createPaystackSubaccount` when a bank destination is created
Use the tenant's name, the provided bank code and account number, and the tenant's `platform_percentage_charge` for the subaccount creation payload
If successful, update the payout destination record with `paystack_subaccount_code` and update the tenant's `payment_setup_status` to 'ready'
If failed, store the error in `paystack_subaccount_error` and set tenant `payment_setup_status` to 'failed'
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Payment Gate & 1% Fee - Public Booking
userStories.description: As a customer booking an appointment, I should be charged a 1% processing fee, and the payment should be routed to the salon's Paystack subaccount.
acceptanceCriteria: Update `create-public-booking` Edge Function to check if tenant's `payment_setup_status` is 'ready'. If not, return an error blocking online payment.
Fetch the tenant's default payout destination to retrieve the `paystack_subaccount_code`
Calculate a 1% processing fee based on the service amount: `fee = round(serviceAmount * 0.01, 2)`
Set the Paystack initialization amount to `Math.round((serviceAmount + fee) * 100)`
Include the `subaccount` field in the Paystack initialization payload
Add metadata: `service_amount`, `processing_fee_rate` (0.01), `processing_fee_amount`, `customer_charged_amount`, and `store_subaccount_code`
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Payment Gate & 1% Fee - Invoices
userStories.description: As a customer paying an invoice, I should be charged a 1% processing fee and the payment should be routed to the salon's subaccount.
acceptanceCriteria: Update `create-invoice-payment-session` Edge Function to require `payment_setup_status` = 'ready'
Calculate the 1% processing fee on the invoice total
Update the Paystack initialization amount to include the fee
Include `subaccount` code in the payload and add detailed fee metadata (similar to US-004)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Webhook Accounting Adjustments
userStories.description: As a salon owner, my wallet should be credited based on the service amount minus the platform cut, ignoring the 1% customer fee.
acceptanceCriteria: Update `payment-webhook-processor.ts` to parse `service_amount` from metadata, falling back to the raw amount if missing
Use `service_amount` to determine if the appointment/invoice is fully paid
When crediting the salon purse, use `service_amount` and deduct the `platform_percentage_charge` if necessary to record the net store earnings
Ensure split payment logic (purse + card) only applies the 1% fee to the card portion
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Update Dashboard Setup Checklist
userStories.description: As a salon owner, I should see a reminder to configure my bank account on the dashboard if I want to accept online payments.
acceptanceCriteria: Update `useDashboardStats` to evaluate the "Configure payments" checklist item based on `currentTenant.payment_setup_status === 'ready'` instead of hardcoding `true`
Update `SalonDashboard.tsx` to show a prominent banner or warning if `payment_setup_status` is not 'ready'
Verify changes work in browser
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Settings UI for Subaccounts
userStories.description: As a salon owner, I want to see the status of my payout destination and subaccount, and I shouldn't be allowed to accept online payments if it's not configured.
acceptanceCriteria: Update `PayoutDestinationsManager.tsx` to display if the Paystack subaccount creation failed, including the `paystack_subaccount_error`
Provide a way to retry creating the subaccount if it failed
Update `BookingWizard.tsx` (Public Booking) to hide Paystack options or show a warning if the salon is not `ready` to accept payments
Verify changes work in browser
Typecheck passes
